default.notes: Apply online for an e-visa before travel, or obtain a visa on arrival at Bissau's Osvaldo Vieira International Airport — arrange the visa in advance if entering by land.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter Guinea-Bissau freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days without a visa.

GW.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Bissau-Guinean citizens.
